Withholding tax payable

The Withholding Tax Payable report displays all withholding tax amounts that have been deducted from payments to this supplier.

When you pay a supplier and withhold tax from the payment, the withheld amount appears here as a liability that you owe to the tax authorities.

This report helps you track how much withholding tax you need to remit to the government for payments made to this specific supplier.

To record a payment to the tax authorities for the withholding tax liability, click the New Payment button at the top of the report.
